title: Nine Dishes of Evening
subtitle: 自助餐与餐饮 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自助餐与餐饮（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：自助餐与餐饮（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：buffet　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 buffet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my mother was sent to serve ① a buffet she could not eat, and she said the eating was the whole of the lesson. The ② buffet, meaning the table and not the food, was nine dishes long and was cleared by whoever came last; a buffet, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ buffet in that hall had the same linen, and the ④ buffet at the end, meaning the one the host laid and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever served properly. A buffet, my grandmother said, is nine parts arrangement and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the arrangement is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ buffet was the whole of the evening, meaning the evening it filled and not the table. The ⑥ buffet, meaning the evening and not any of that, is the only thing in a hotel that everybody praises and nobody questions; a buffet, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a table and an evening. She said the evening is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ buffet had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the linen. The ⑧ buffet of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine dishes and eleven years of serving; a buffet, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ buffet I remember is the one at the end, which was shared in 1980 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ buffet, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every buffet, she said, is an evening that has agreed to look like a table. She said the evening was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 自助餐（指那张餐台本身，与食物相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve a buffet 布置／供应自助餐
D. n. 自助餐（指那座厅里每一场）
E. n. 自助餐（指末尾那一场）
F. n. 自助餐（抽象：它填满的那个夜晚）
G. n. 那个夜晚（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a buffet she could not eat
The buffet, meaning the table and not the food
buffet was the whole of the evening
the buffet had become a photograph in a report

answers.why: serve a buffet 意为“布置／供应自助餐”，1962 年母亲被派去操办一场她吃不上的自助餐。
buffet 意为“自助餐”，指那张餐台本身而不是食物，共九道菜，由最后走的人收拾。
buffet 指那座厅里每一场自助餐，每一场都是同样的桌布。
buffet 指末尾那一场（主人摆的那一场），是唯一有人认真操办过的。
buffet 意为“自助餐”，抽象指它填满的那个夜晚，父亲说 buffet 就是那个夜晚的全部。
buffet 为抽象用法，指那个夜晚本身，是饭店里人人都夸、却没人质疑的东西。
buffet 意为“自助餐”，到 1976 年这场 buffet 成了报告里的一张照片。
buffet 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九道菜和十一年的操办。
buffet 意为“自助餐”，我记得的是末尾那一场，1980 年被分着吃，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
buffet 为抽象总称，祖母说自助餐是唯一会因为被分着吃而变好的东西。
